1331: worthless, lowly, the worst of the wicked.
For the poor, the Name and His love are wealth.
ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ; ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
This wealth is excellent; all other wealth is poison and ashes. ॥4॥
Praise or slander, the Word and its contemplation —
hail to the One who gives them.
Whomever You forgive has status and honour.
Nanak speaks as He makes him speak. ॥5॥12॥
ਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ; ਪੈਧੈ. ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
Eating, one adds to the filth; wearing finery, one ruins one's inner home.
ਬਕਿ ਬਕਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
Babbling and babbling, one starts quarrels; without the Name, know it all to be poison. ॥1॥
ਬਾਬਾ. ਐਸਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਜਾਲਿ; ਮਨੁ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥
O brother, the mind is caught in such a treacherous net.
Crossing the turbulent waters, one comes to poise and is enlightened. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ. ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
One eats poison, speaks poison, and does poisonous deeds.
ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ; ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Bound at death's door, one is beaten; one is released only through the True Name. ॥2॥
ਜਿਵ ਆਇਆ. ਤਿਵ ਜਾਇਸੀ; ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
As one came, so one departs, taking the record of one's deeds.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
The self-willed lose even their capital, and are punished in the Lord's Court. ॥3॥
ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ. ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੌ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀਂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
The world is false; the True One is pure; reflect on this through the Guru's Word.
ਤੇ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Rare are those who have the wisdom of the Lord within. ॥4॥
ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ. ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ; ਅਮਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
One who endures the unendurable finds the spring flowing of the immortal Lord, the embodiment of bliss.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ; ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ, ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
Nanak longs for You as the fish for water; as it pleases You, keep me in Your love. ॥5॥13॥
Songs, music, pleasures and clever tricks,
fine clothes and food — they do not touch my consciousness.
True poise and peace come from enshrining the Name. ॥1॥
What do I know of what He does and makes me do?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਤਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name nothing pleases my being. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The delights of yoga, the tastes and joys,
understanding and true love — all are in devotion to the Lord of the universe.
Singing His praises is my own work and deed.
The Sovereign Lord, the Illuminator, pervades within. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
With love and affection I have enshrined the Beloved, the Beloved in my heart.
He is the Master of the meek, my Husband, the Lord of the forests.
Night and day, the Name and giving it to others are my vow.
Reflecting on the essence, I am satisfied and freed from the waves. ॥3॥
What power have I to speak of the Indescribable?
I worship You only as You make me worship.
When You dwell within, "I" and "mine" are gone.
Whom else should I serve? There is no other. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
The Guru's Word is supremely sweet and sublime.
Such is the nectar I have seen within.
One who tastes it attains the perfect state.
Nanak, one is satisfied and there is peace within. ॥5॥14॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਰਾਂਗਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Seeing Him within through the Word, the mind is satisfied; there is no other who can dye it.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Day and night He watches over and cares for His beings; His alone is the sovereignty. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਰਾਂਗਿ ਘਣੌ ਅਤਿ ਰੂੜੌ ॥
My God is dyed in the deepest colour, and utterly beautiful.
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ; ਅਤਿ ਰਸ, ਲਾਲ ਸਗੂੜੌ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Merciful to the meek, my Beloved, the Enticer of hearts, sublime and deep crimson. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਊਪਰਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
The well is high above, in the sky of the mind; the one who draws from it drinks the nectar.
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ, ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
He whose creation it is knows the way; through the Guru one reflects on wisdom. ॥2॥
1332: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ, ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ; ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
His rays spread out and the lotus blossoms in delight; the sun merges into the house of the moon.
ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਧੁੰਸਿ, ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Death is destroyed and the mind's desires subdued; by the Guru's grace God is found. ॥3॥
ਅਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ; ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Dyed in the deep crimson of His love, there is no other colour.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਰਾਤੇ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
Nanak, those whose tongues savour His essence are imbued with Him; God pervades all. ॥4॥15॥
ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਚਹੁ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
The yogis of the twelve sects and the renunciates of the ten waste away.
ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਸਿਰਖੂਥੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
The patch-coated yogis and those who pluck out their hair — without the Word, the noose is around their necks. ॥1॥
Those attuned to the Word are perfectly detached.
ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਚੀ; ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They beg for alms from the Lord within the heart, lovingly attuned to the One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ. ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Brahmins study and debate, perform rituals and have rituals performed.
ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Without understanding they see nothing; the self-willed, separated from Him, suffer. ॥2॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ; ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Those united through the Word are pure in conduct; they are honoured in the True Court.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
Night and day they are attuned to the jewel of the Name; through the ages they merge in the True One. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ; ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ. ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
All rituals, religious duties, purity, self-discipline, chanting, austerity and pilgrimage dwell in the Word.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਕਾਲ ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
Nanak, one whom He unites meets the true Guru, and pain, sin and death run away. ॥4॥16॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ, ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
The dust of the saints and the company of the holy — the Lord's praise is the raft to swim across.
ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
What can poor death do? It is afraid of the Guru-facing one, in whose heart is the Lord. ॥1॥
Let a life without the Name burn away.
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I chant and chant the Lord's Name, telling it on the rosary; through the Guru the mind tastes its flavour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
One who has the true peace of the Guru's teaching — what praise can be given to him?
ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ; ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
Searching, the Guru-facing one finds rubies, gems, jewels and treasure. ॥2॥
ਚੀਨੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ; ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
He recognises wisdom and meditation, the true wealth, and is lovingly attuned to the One Word.
ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
He enters the trance of the Fearless Lord, who needs no support or food and is free of all desire. ॥3॥
ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ; ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
The seven seas within are filled with pure water, and the overturned boat floats across.
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੌ. ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
He restrains the mind from wandering outside, and through the Guru merges in poise. ॥4॥
ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ. ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
He alone is a householder, he alone a detached servant, who through the Guru recognises his own self.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ, ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੫॥੧੭॥
Says Nanak, there is no other; the mind is satisfied by the True Word. ॥5॥17॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Rare is the one who, through the Guru, understands that He pervades all through the Word.
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Imbued with the Name, one is ever at peace, lovingly attuned to the True One. ॥1॥
1333: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, O humble brothers.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace the mind becomes steady, and night and day is satisfied with the Lord's essence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Worship Him night and day; this is the profit of this age, brother.
ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ, ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
His humble servants are ever pure; no filth sticks to them, their minds fixed on the True Name. ॥2॥
ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
The true Guru has shown the adornment of peace; great is the glory of the Name.
ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ, ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
The inexhaustible treasures are full and never run short; serve the Lord forever, brother. ॥3॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
The Creator Himself gives it, and it comes to dwell in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, meditate forever on the Name; the true Guru has revealed it. ॥4॥1॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Forgive me, the worthless one, O Master, and unite me with Yourself.
ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
You are infinite; no one has found Your limit; through the Word grant me understanding. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ. ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਉ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I dedicate my body and mind and place them before You; may I remain in Your sanctuary forever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Keep me forever in Your will, O Master; bless me with Your Name — that is my honour.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ ਜਾਪੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Through the perfect Guru His will is understood, and night and day one merges in poise. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
If it pleases You, devotion happens in Your will; You Yourself forgive and unite us.
ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
In Your will one has found lasting peace; the Guru has quenched the fire of craving. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ, ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ, ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak, there is no giver as great as the Name; it is obtained from the perfect Guru. ॥4॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿੰਨਾ; ਤਿਨ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Those who praised the Lord through the Guru — by praising, they came to know Him.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Doubt and duality have gone from within; through the Guru's Word they have recognised Him. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Dear Lord, You alone are my One, my caretaker.
ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ. ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ. ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I meditate on You, I praise You; liberation and wisdom come from You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ. ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Those who praise Him through the Guru savour its taste; the sweet nectar is sublime.
ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
It is ever sweet, never bland, when one reflects through the Guru's Word. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ, ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
He who made it sweet alone knows; I am a sacrifice to Him.
ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
Through the Word I praise forever the Giver of peace, shedding self-conceit from within. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ. ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
My true Guru is forever the Giver; whatever one desires, that fruit one receives.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak, the Name is obtained — that is true glory; through the Guru's Word one attains the True One. ॥4॥3॥
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ. ਤੂ ਰਾਖਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Dear Lord, those who come to Your sanctuary — You are able to protect them.
ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ, ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ, ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
I can see no other as great as You; there has never been, nor ever will be. ॥1॥
Dear Lord, may I remain in Your sanctuary forever.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As it pleases You, protect me, my Master; this is Your greatness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Dear Lord, those who come to Your sanctuary — You cherish and sustain them.
1334: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਪੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
In Your mercy You Yourself protect them, dear Lord, and death cannot touch them. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Your sanctuary is true, dear Lord; it neither diminishes nor passes away.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ, ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ; ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
One who abandons the Lord and clings to the love of duality is born and dies. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨਾ. ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Dear Lord, those who come to Your sanctuary suffer no pain or hunger.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Nanak, praise the Name forever, and you will merge in the True Word. ॥4॥4॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
Through the Guru, meditate forever on the Lord, as long as there is life and breath.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the mind becomes pure, and pride is removed from it.
ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੇਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
Fruitful is the life of that mortal who is absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
O my mind, listen to the Guru's teaching:
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord's Name is forever the giver of peace; in poise, drink in the Lord's essence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਨਿ. ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Those who recognise their origin dwell in their own true home, and peace comes in poise.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the heart-lotus blossoms, and ego and evil-mindedness are dispelled.
ਸਭਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
The One True Lord pervades all; rare is the one who understands this. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching the mind becomes pure, and one chants the nectar Name of the Lord, the essence of all.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
The Lord's Name dwells forever in the mind, and the mind is satisfied within itself.
ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom one recognises the all-pervading Lord. ॥3॥
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ, ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
One who in this human life has not served the true Guru has wasted life in vain.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
When He casts His glance of grace, He unites one with the true Guru, and one remains merged in poise.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Nanak, one who receives the glory of the Name meditates on it by perfect destiny. ॥4॥5॥
ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਏ, ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ; ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
He Himself fashions creation in many kinds and colours; creating the world, God has staged this play.
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ. ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ; ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਨੋ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
Having made it, He watches over it; He acts and causes all to act, and gives sustenance to all beings. ॥1॥
One who in this age of strife has dwelt on the Lord —
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one God pervading every heart — in that Guru-facing one the Lord's Name becomes manifest. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਪਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ. ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
In this dark age the Name is present but hidden; the Lord fills every heart.
ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ. ਤਿਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
The jewel of the Name is revealed in the hearts of those who hasten to the Guru's sanctuary. ॥2॥
ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪੰਚ. ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੈ; ਖਿਮਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
One who obtains forgiveness and contentment through the Guru's teaching brings the five senses under control.
ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ; ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ, ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Blessed, blessed is that servant of the Lord, great and perfect, who in awe and detachment sings the Lord's praises. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ. ਜੇ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ. ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
If someone turns away from the Guru and does not keep the Guru's word in mind,
ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰ. ਬਹੁ ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੈ; ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੪॥
though he performs rituals and gathers great wealth, whatever he does, he falls into hell. ॥4॥
ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ. ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਭ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ. ਉਤਪਤਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
The One Word, the One God pervades; all creation proceeds from the One.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੈ ॥੫॥੬॥
Nanak, through the Guru He unites one in union; through the Guru one goes and merges in the Lord. ॥5॥6॥
O my mind, praise your Guru,
1335: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and with perfect destiny shining on your forehead, sing the Lord's praises forever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Lord gives the nectar Name as food,
but only one in millions receives it —
the one on whom He casts His glance of grace. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Enshrine the Guru's feet in your mind,
and pain and darkness depart from within;
the True One Himself unites you with Him. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Embrace love for the Guru's Word;
here and hereafter, it is the support.
The True One leads one to accept His will;
that devotee alone is graceful, wise and discerning.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥7॥17॥7॥24॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ; ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching let us sing His praises with relish and delight; then the mind is attuned to the Name in a state of longing.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru's Word I have drunk the nectar essence; I am a sacrifice to the Name. ॥1॥
The Lord, the Life of the world, is our very breath.
ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਇਓ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The sublime Lord became dear within the heart when the Guru spoke His mantra into the ears. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ. ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ ॥
Come, saints, my brothers, let us meet; meeting, let us chant the Name of the Lord.
ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥
By what way and how can my God be found? Give me this teaching as a gift. ॥2॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
The Lord dwells in the true congregation; meeting in the congregation, one comes to know His virtues.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
By great fortune one finds the true congregation, and touching the Guru's feet, meets God. ॥3॥
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ॥
Let us sing the praises of the inaccessible Lord and Master; singing His praises, we are lost in wonder.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਖਿਨ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
The Guru showed mercy to servant Nanak and in an instant gave him the gift of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥1॥
ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ; ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
As the sun rises the Guru-facing chant the Lord's Name; all night long too they dwell on the Lord's praises.
ਹਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ; ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
My God has instilled this longing in me too, and I search for God, the Lord. ॥1॥
My mind has become the dust of the Guru's feet.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has implanted the Lord's sweet Name within me; I dust the Guru's feet with my hair. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ; ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
For the faithless, day and night are pitch dark; they are caught in attachment, in the net of Maya.
ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ. ਨ ਵਸਿਓ; ਰਿਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨॥
Not for an instant does the Lord God dwell in their hearts; they are bound by debt in many ways, every hair. ॥2॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ; ਹਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ॥
Meeting the true congregation, one gains wisdom and understanding; ego goes and the net of possessiveness is cut.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ. ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥
The Lord's Name becomes sweet; through the Word the Guru has made one blissful. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਗੁਰ. ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
We are Your children, O Guru, inaccessible Master; O Guru, be merciful and cherish us.
ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ, ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੨॥
We are drowning in the poisonous world-ocean — pull us out, O God, Guru Nanak, Sustainer of the world; we are Your children. ॥4॥2॥
ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਕ ॥
When the Lord God showed mercy even for an instant, they sang His praises, savouring His delight.
1336: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
Both the singers and the listeners were liberated — those who, through the Guru, drank in the Lord even for an instant. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
Within my mind the essence of the Lord's Name abides.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru I found the cooling water of the Name, and drank the Lord's essence in deep draughts. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ; ਤਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਊਜਲ ਟੀਕ ॥
Those in whose hearts love for the Lord is kindled bear a radiant mark on their foreheads.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਰਿ; ਜਿਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਡਵਾ. ਸਸਿ ਕੀਕ ॥੨॥
The glory of the Lord's servants spreads over all the world, like the moon among the stars. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵਸਿਓ; ਤਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਫੀਕ ॥
Those in whose hearts the Lord's Name does not dwell — all their works are insipid,
ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ, ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ; ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ, ਨਕਟੇ ਨਕ ਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
like a body adorned with finery: without the Name they are like one whose nose is cut off. ॥3॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਈਕ ॥
The beautiful sovereign Lord pervades every heart; the One is present in all, everywhere.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਘਰੀ ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
The Lord showed mercy to servant Nanak, and through the Guru's word he meditates on Him every moment. ॥4॥3॥
ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
The inaccessible, merciful God showed grace, and I chanted the Lord's Name with my mouth.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ; ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
Those who meditated on the Name of the Purifier of sinners were rid of all their sins and misdeeds. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
O mind, chant the Name of the all-pervading Lord.
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who sang of the Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain, found the treasure of the Name through the Guru's teaching. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ. ਨਗਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹੇ ॥
The Lord dwells in the city of every body, but only through the Guru's teaching is this realised.
ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
In the pool of the body where the Lord's Name is revealed, one finds the Lord God in the home, the temple of the heart. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ; ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
Those who wander and wander in the wilderness are faithless fools, plundered.
ਜਿਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਭਿ, ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
Like the deer, the musk's fragrance dwells in its own navel, yet it roams about sniffing the bushes. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
You are great, inaccessible and unfathomable, O God; grant me understanding, that I may find You, Lord.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
The Guru placed his hand on servant Nanak's head, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥4॥
ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ ॥
Love for the Lord's Name took hold of the mind, and one meditated on the Lord, the great God,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਫਾ ॥੧॥
on whom the Lord God showed mercy; the true Guru's words became pleasing to the heart. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
O my mind, vibrate on the Lord's Name every instant.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਫਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The perfect Guru gave the gift of the Lord, and the Lord's Name came to dwell in mind and body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ; ਜਪਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਪਫਾ ॥
The Lord dwells in the city of the body, its home and temple; the Guru-facing chant and sing His glory.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਫਾ ॥੨॥
Here and hereafter His servants are at peace; their faces radiant, the Guru-facing cross over. ॥2॥
ਅਨਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
Those attuned to the fearless Lord, who through the Guru enshrined Him in the heart even for an instant —
ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ. ਇਕ ਪਲਫਾ ॥੩॥
the Lord wiped out all of that servant's sins of millions of lives in a single moment. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖਫਾ ॥
Your servants become known through You alone, O God; those who know You become honoured.
1337: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
The Lord has placed Himself within His servants; servant Nanak and the Lord God are one. ॥4॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਭਾ ॥
The true Guru implanted the Lord's Name within; we were dead, and chanting the Lord we live again.
ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ. ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਢਿਭਾ ॥੧॥
Blessed, blessed is the perfect Guru, the true Guru, who gives his arm and pulls out those drowning in poison. ॥1॥
O mind, chant the Lord's Name, worthy of worship.
ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਤਹੂ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is never found by whispered mantras or other devices; through the perfect Guru the Lord God is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਭਾ ॥
The essence of the Lord's Name is the treasure of all essences; it is drunk through the delight of the Guru's teaching.
ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ, ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ; ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿਭਾ ॥੨॥
Rusted iron becomes gold; so, joining the congregation, one enshrines the Lord in the heart, and through the Guru the Lord is revealed. ॥2॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ; ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਿਭਾ ॥
Those ever caught in ego, in poison and greed, entangled in attachment to children and spouse,
ਤਿਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ. ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ; ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ ॥੩॥
who have never served the feet of the saints — those self-willed ones smoulder like embers in ashes. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ; ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਰਿ. ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ ॥
You alone know Your virtues, O God; defeated, we have come to Your sanctuary.
ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ. ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
As You see fit, protect me, O Master; servant Nanak is Your slave. ॥4॥6॥ Set of six 1 ॥
Prabhati Bibhas · Partal · Guru Ram Das
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
O mind, chant the Lord's Name, the treasure.
You will be honoured in the Lord's Court.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ; ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who chanted it have crossed over. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Listen, O mind, and meditate on the Lord's Name.
ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
Listen, O mind: the Lord's praise is bathing at the sixty-eight pilgrimage places.
Listen, O mind, through the Guru, and you will be honoured. ॥1॥
O mind, chant the Name of the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme.
In an instant it destroys millions of sins.
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
The Lord made your mind and fashioned your whole body,
formed it of the five elements and graced it with His light,
gave you the earth for a bed and water to use —
do not forget Him even for an instant; serve the Lord of the world. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
O mind, serve the true Guru and attain the supreme state.
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ. ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ; ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If you remain detached from joy and sorrow, you will find the Lord of life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He gives you clothes and many delicacies to enjoy,
and made mother, father and all your family;
He provides sustenance in water and on land, O friend —
serve that Lord, forever and ever. ॥2॥
ਤਹਾ ਸਖਾਈ; ਜਹ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
He is the companion there where no one else can help;
ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ; ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
He washes away millions of misdeeds in an instant.
He gives His gifts and never regrets them.
ਏਕਾ ਬਖਸ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Whom He forgives once, He never calls to account again. ॥3॥
1338: By the destiny of past deeds, I searched and found Him;
the Lord of the world dwells in the company of the holy.
Meeting the Guru, I have come to Your door.
Grant servant Nanak the sight of You, O Lord. ॥4॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
Serving God brings glory to His servant;
his lust, anger and greed are erased.
Your Name is in Your servant's storehouse.
They sing Your praises, in love with the sight of You, O God. ॥1॥
O God, You Yourself have made Your devotion known,
ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and cutting their bonds, You have freed Your servants. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Those servants imbued with God's love
ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
have found peace in God's company.
Only one who tastes this delight knows it;
beholding Him again and again, one is lost in wonder within. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
He is at peace, he is the most exalted of all,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ; ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
in whose heart that God dwells.
He alone is steady; he does not come and go.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
Night and day he sings the Lord God's praises. ॥3॥
Let all bow before that one
in whose mind is the perfect Formless Lord.
Have mercy on me, O Lord and Master,
that Nanak may be saved by serving Your servants. ॥4॥2॥
Singing His praises, the mind is in bliss.
Twenty-four hours a day I remember the Lord.
By whose grace, through remembrance, sins depart —
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ; ਹਮ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
I fall at the feet of that Guru. ॥1॥
Grant me wise understanding, O beloved saint Guru,
that I may remember the Name, which carries me across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru who has shown the straight path,
by whom one forsakes all else and is absorbed in the Lord's Name —
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ; ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
to that Guru let us be forever a sacrifice,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
from whom remembrance of the Lord is obtained. ॥2॥
The Guru who carried drowning mortals across,
by whose grace Maya does not entice,
the Guru who has embellished this world and the next —
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
to that Guru I am forever a sacrifice. ॥3॥
From the greatest fool he has made one wise.
The story of the perfect Guru is beyond telling.
Nanak, through the divine Guru, the Supreme Lord,
by great fortune, the Lord's service is obtained. ॥4॥3॥
ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟੇ. ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ; ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
All pains are erased and peace bestowed on those He has made to chant His Name.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ; ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
In His mercy He has linked them to His service and wiped out all their sin. ॥1॥
We children seek the sanctuary of merciful God.
ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ. ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ. ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Cutting away their faults, God has made them His own; my Guru, the Lord of the world, has protected them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Fever and sin were destroyed in an instant when the Lord of the world became merciful.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
With every breath I worship the Supreme Lord; I am a sacrifice to my true Guru. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The Master is inaccessible, beyond the senses and infinite; His limit cannot be found.
ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
Meditate on your God; earning this profit, one becomes truly wealthy. ॥3॥
1339: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Twenty-four hours a day I meditate on the Supreme Lord, and forever sing His praises.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have found the Guru, the Supreme Lord. ॥4॥4॥
Remembering the Name, all sins are destroyed.
The Guru has given the capital of the True Name.
They are glorious in God's Court;
serving Him, His servants are forever beautiful. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, my brothers.
ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All diseases and faults are destroyed, and the darkness of ignorance leaves the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru has ended birth and death, O friend,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
for those who have come to love the Lord's Name.
The sufferings of millions of lives are gone.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਭਲ ਹੋਸ ॥੨॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru,
by whose grace I meditate on the Lord's Name.
Such a Guru is found by great fortune,
meeting whom one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥3॥
Have mercy, O Supreme Lord and Master,
Keep me attuned to You twenty-four hours a day;
In His mercy God has made them His own,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
and given them the Lord's Name to chant.
Twenty-four hours a day sing the praises of the Lord of the universe;
fears are destroyed and all anxiety is lifted. ॥1॥
Clinging to the true Guru's feet, they are saved.
ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ, ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever the Guru says seems good and sweet, when one gives up the mind's own cleverness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
That Lord God dwells in mind and body;
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
no strife or suffering stands in the way.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
God is ever with the soul;
filth is washed away in the love of the Name. ॥2॥
Love for His lotus feet has taken hold;
lust, anger and ego are destroyed.
One who has learned the way to meet God —
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
through loving devotion, his mind is won over by the Lord. ॥3॥
Listen, friends, saints and companions: they are at peace
who have gained the jewel of the Name of the unfathomable, immeasurable Lord.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Forever sing the praises of God, the treasure of virtue.
Says Nanak, this is obtained by great fortune. ॥4॥6॥
They are the truly wealthy, the true bankers,
who have bought the Name and are honoured in the Lord's Court. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, my friend.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The perfect Guru, whose way is pure and perfect, is found by great fortune. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One earns the profit and celebration resounds within,
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
singing the Lord's praises by the saint Guru's grace. ॥2॥
Fruitful is that life, and accepted;
by the Guru's grace, enjoy the Lord's love. ॥3॥
Lust, anger and ego are destroyed;
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਪੂਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ॥
The Guru is perfect; perfect is his power.
1340: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਅਟਲਾ ॥
The Guru's Word is forever unchanging.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
One in whose mind the Guru's Word dwells —
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
all his pain and suffering run away. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Imbued with the Lord's love, the mind sings the Lord's praises;
one who bathes in the dust of the holy Guru's feet is liberated. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace they cross over;
fear, doubt and corruption are destroyed.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
Within their mind and body dwell the Guru's feet;
the holy are fearless, having taken the Lord's sanctuary. ॥2॥
They enjoy bliss, poise, delight and abundant peace;
no enemy or pain comes near them.
The perfect Guru has made them his own and protected them;
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
chanting the Lord's Name, all their sins are washed away. ॥3॥
The saints, friends and Sikhs are at peace,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲੈ ਮੇਲੇ ॥
whom the perfect Guru has united with God.
He has cut the painful noose of birth and death.
Says Nanak, the Guru has covered their failings and kept their honour. ॥4॥8॥
The perfect true Guru has given the Name;
ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
there is bliss, joy, salvation and lasting peace, and every task is accomplished. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ; ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
The Guru's lotus feet have come to dwell in the mind;
pain, suffering and false doubts are destroyed. ॥1॥
ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Rise each day and sing God's Word;
twenty-four hours a day remember the Lord, O mortal. ॥2॥
Inside and outside, God is everywhere;
wherever I go, He is with me as my helper. ॥3॥
With palms pressed together I offer this prayer:
may Nanak forever chant the Name of the treasure of virtue. ॥4॥9॥
The Supreme Lord God, graceful and all-wise,
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
is found when by great fortune one finds the perfect Guru; to see him, offer yourself as a sacrifice. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the Word he erased sins and gave contentment,
and one became worthy of worshipping the Name.
In the company of the holy there is enlightenment,
and the lotus feet dwell within the mind. ॥1॥
God is perfect, the Master of the masterless.
One whom He honours, showing mercy —
perfect are his deeds and conduct. ॥2॥
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ; ਨਿਤ ਨਵੇ ॥
He sings His praises day after day, ever fresh and new;
he does not wander through the 8.4 million species.
Here and hereafter he is honoured;
his face is radiant in the True Court. ॥3॥
One on whose forehead the Guru places his hand —
such a servant is rare, one in millions.
He sees the Lord pervading water, land and sky.
ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Nanak, you will be saved by the dust of such a servant's feet. ॥4॥10॥
I am a sacrifice to my perfect Guru,
ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by whose grace I chant the chant of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Hearing his nectar Word, I am enraptured,
and the entanglements of Maya are destroyed. ॥1॥
Love for the True Word has taken hold,
and my Lord God has come into my consciousness. ॥2॥
Chanting the Name, I am enlightened.
